calls.title: Porsche Informatik & Growthbook POC Scoping
calls.summary: The discussion centered around initiating a 30-day proof of concept (PoC) to validate GrowthBook’s experimentation capabilities related to contact form submissions. Jakob confirmed the integration of BigQuery and SDK into the frontend, emphasizing that the PoC's success relies on smooth implementation rather than immediate metric uplift. The primary focus will be on contact form submissions as the initial test case, with plans for data analysis through GA4 into BigQuery. The team agreed to hold weekly meetings to track progress and troubleshoot issues, while budget and approval processes for adopting GrowthBook involve formal steps that are governed by a centralized department. The desired launch timeline is late summer, but organizational constraints may affect this schedule.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, BigQuery, Google Analytics 4, Proof of Concept, Contact Form Experimentation, Procurement Process
